# XEEDROID (https://dilshancode.github.io/xeedroid-web/)

> XEEDROID is an independent technology platform, YouTube channel, and software resource hub specializing in practical Windows 11 tutorials, PC performance tuning, software walkthroughs, debloating techniques, and gadget reviews.

## Core Topics & Expertise
- **Windows 11 Setup & Optimization:** Official clean installation methods, bypassing hardware restrictions (TPM/CPU/RAM) via Rufus, privacy debloating, and background telemetry removal.
- **System Utilities & Free Software:** Open-source power tools, disk cloning (Clonezilla, Macrium), virtualization (VMware Workstation, VirtualBox), and media production apps.
- **Troubleshooting & Fixes:** Blue screen analysis, Windows update repair, driver installation guides, audio/video stutter resolution, and storage reclamation.
- **Tech News & Software Releases:** Curated dispatches on open-source releases, Windows feature updates, and AI tooling.

## Key Sections & Pages
- **Home Hub:** https://dilshancode.github.io/xeedroid-web/ — Featured video masterclasses, latest uploads, and topic overview.
- **Video Library:** https://dilshancode.github.io/xeedroid-web/videos.html — Complete searchable catalog of YouTube video tutorials with timestamps and step-by-step notes.
- **Tech Dispatches & News:** https://dilshancode.github.io/xeedroid-web/posts.html — Tech updates, release roundups, and practical tips.
- **About & Social Profiles:** https://dilshancode.github.io/xeedroid-web/about.html — Channel background, verified hardware specs, creator setup, and official community links.
- **Editorial Standards:** https://dilshancode.github.io/xeedroid-web/editorial.html — Testing methodology, software safety guidelines, and independent review policy.
